scenarios.title: Two concurrent confirms redeem one reference exactly once

gherkin.given: a live pending confirm holds one reference for an authenticated user and two confirm attempts for that reference are released simultaneously
gherkin.then: exactly one attempt returns a populated ConfirmResult, the other returns ErrPendingNotFound, the gated action has executed exactly once, and exactly one confirmed audit row exists

scenarios.title: Two concurrent HTTP confirms with distinct message ids execute once

gherkin.given: a live pending confirm holds one reference and two POSTs to the assistant turn endpoint both carry that reference under different transport_message_id values
gherkin.then: the gated action has executed exactly once and exactly one response reports a successful confirmation

scenarios.title: A confirm racing the timeout sweep yields one terminal outcome

gherkin.given: a pending confirm holds one reference whose expiry has elapsed and a confirm attempt and a timeout sweep for that reference run concurrently
gherkin.then: exactly one terminal audit row exists for the reference and it is either confirmed or discarded_timeout but never both

gherkin.given: a live pending confirm holds one reference
gherkin.when: a single confirm for that reference is issued and then replayed
gherkin.then: the first returns a populated ConfirmResult and executes the action once, the replay returns ErrPendingNotFound without executing again, and the other conversation columns are unchanged
